desc: Betty Crocker Delights Super Moist Dark Chocolate Cake Mix is made with pudding in the mix to create a rich and decadent flavor and texture. Ready to bake in minutes, this dark chocolate cake can be topped with delicious frosting for a classic take, or try something new with one of Betty Crocker's many baking mix recipes. Plus, it can also be used as cupcake mix! Bring your family together with the perfect balance of sweet flavor and convenience. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes. And today, you can still find those same products you grew up with on grocery shelves.
features:
Rich, super-moist texture thanks to pudding mix baked in. 

Versatile—ideal for cakes, cupcakes, or cake pops. 

ust add 3 eggs, water & vegetable oil—bakes in minutes. 

Kosher and preservative-free.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Salt, Monoglycerides, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Natural and Artificial Flavor.
